findings.reason: The problem statement invents a new neural retriever, cloud training and a 50 percent latency target. The sources request a local investigation and evidence-grounded report, explicitly deferring method selection.
The artifact includes the requested investigation and report, deferred method selection, locality requirement, baseline latency and retrieval-quality metrics, and absence of empirical measurements.

Requiring a neural retriever contradicts the prohibition on choosing a method; requiring cloud training contradicts keeping all work local. The invented improvement target also conflicts with the source-grounded scope.

Although the requested report has a clear purpose, the contradictory problem statement introduces an unauthorized implementation and quantitative target. The artifact cannot reliably guide execution within its mandatory constraints.

limitations: No empirical measurements are supplied; actual retrieval performance cannot be assessed from these sources.
required_correction: Remove the unsupported neural-retriever, cloud-training and 50 percent improvement requirements from the problem statement and align it with the local investigation and evidence-grounded report requested by the sources.
